note: The page gives the fees by validity, not by age; whether a minor may have ten years is a lead. The first- and second-class passports (LBP 20,000,000 to 60,000,000) aren't modelled.

sources.title: General Security (general-security.gov.lb), Biometric passport
sources.said: Fees: Document requested Fees Passport valid for 5 years 6,000,000 L.L Passport valid for 10 years 10,000,000 L.L Passport – first class - 5 years 30,000,000 L.L Passport – second class - 5 years 20,000,000 L.L Passport – first class - 10 years 60,000,000 L.L Passport – second class - 10 years 40,000,000 L.L NB: To receive the passport immediately , the interested party can apply at the department of public relations. An additional fee of LBP 9,800,000 will be however requested.
